scope: Eight generic lemmas: noncommutative inverse difference, rank-one column action and replacement, Cramer numerator invariance, same-determinant-sign negative quotient transfer, nondecreasing endpoint steps, convex combination bounds and a finite replacement chain. Analytic derivative bounds, closed-hull/integral membership, connectedness and the assembled concrete ACS theorem remain written or computational.
